name: Rockland Plaza
summary: Rockland Plaza is a 251,589 square foot community shopping center in Nanuet, NY, featuring national retailers like ULTA Beauty, Five Below, Shake Shack, and Chipotle. Currently undergoing a $33 million redevelopment through 2027, the center serves an affluent trade area with 127,000+ residents and attracts 3.4 million annual visits.
demographics: Rockland Plaza serves an affluent and dense trade area with over 127,000 residents within 3 miles, featuring an average household income of $146,393. The center draws from all of Rockland County, NY, attracting approximately 3.4 million annual visits with strong appeal to middle-to-upper income families and professionals. The demographic profile includes established households with significant purchasing power, drawn to the mix of value-oriented retailers like Five Below and Dollar Tree alongside premium services such as ULTA Beauty and specialty dining options like Shake Shack and Chipotle.
description: Rockland Plaza is a prominent 251,589 square foot community shopping center located at 76 Rockland Plaza in Nanuet, New York, serving as a retail hub for all of Rockland County. The center benefits from exceptional visibility and accessibility with over 42,000 vehicles per day passing on State Route 59, plus convenient access to major thoroughfares including the NYS Thruway, Palisades Parkway, and Garden State Parkway. The property features a strong lineup of national retailers and restaurants including Shake Shack, ULTA Beauty, Five Below, Chipotle, Panera Bread, and J.Crew Factory, drawing an estimated 3.4 million annual visits. Currently undergoing a significant $33 million redevelopment project scheduled for completion in the fourth quarter of 2027, Rockland Plaza is being transformed to better serve its affluent trade area of 127,000+ residents with an average household income exceeding $146,000 within three miles. The center combines value retailers, specialty services including Orangetheory Fitness and StretchLab, dining destinations, and essential services like Chase Bank and AAA Insurance, creating a comprehensive shopping and lifestyle destination for Rockland County residents.
